resets.asserted_meaning: Asynchronously returns the state to S0.

ports.name: in
ports.role: Four-state serial sequence input sampled by the combinational transition decoder.

ports.name: out
ports.role: Four-state Mealy sequence-detection pulse for input sequence 1101.

declared_unknowns.description: The RTL state register has no declaration-time initialization; the test checks its unknown output before asserting asynchronous reset.
A directed X input causes a ternary-generated unknown state; the RTL default-state branch assigns next_state but leaves out unchanged, and recovery is checked. Z input is not separately exercised.
RTL state parameters S0..S3 are represented by their defaults (0..3); non-default parameter overrides are not implemented or tested.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
